line.text: The line for delivery on the receipt and the invoice. Receipts add the VAT rate to its name, for example "Koszt dostawy 23%".
line.whyTerm: Why the rate is in the name
line.whyText: Fiscal printers keep one VAT rate per line name and refuse a name whose rate goes up. A name with the rate in it never changes rate.

rate.fixedText: Delivery always gets the rate you choose.
rate.goodsText: Delivery gets the VAT rate of the products. If an order has products at different rates, delivery is split between them by value.
rate.spreadText: There is no delivery line. Its cost is added to the product prices on the document.
